document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Protein A Chromatography (Step 5)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. ProcessParameter.NOR is the NOR the studies were planned and judged against, which is the NOR the plan prints; the narrower protein load NOR that PCR-005 Version 2.0 put in force is a statement anchored on the footnote of the parameter table. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range.

The nrCE-SDS retest of retained samples S-PA-RET has no StudyDesign.study_type; it appears only as a row of the execution-window table. The hold study S-PA-HLD is not a study of this plan: it was made during the Version 2.0 re-analysis and PCR-005 records it as a discrepancy from the plan (PD-005-05).
acceptance_criteria holds the rows of the criteria-change table (Version 1.0 analysis limit, superseded, and the Version 2.0 criteria, in force).
Step yield is a performance attribute with no acceptance criterion; it is the concept attr:step_yield in the prior-knowledge assertions.
The methods table names each method by its title. Each AnalyticalMethod record is also anchored on the row of the procedures table that ties the title to its AMV.

The planned design matrices (Appendices A and B), the factor letter codes and the table of downstream values the criteria rest on are not represented row by row. No rhetorical_spans: the Version 1.0 annex carried none for this plan, and none were curated for Version 2.0. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: The capture step of the purification train, operated in bind and elute mode. The resin binds the antibody from the clarified harvest, most host cell protein and DNA leave in the flow-through and the wash, and the antibody is eluted at low pH and passed to low-pH viral inactivation (Step 6) without neutralization. The step adds leached Protein A ligand.
output_materials: Protein A eluate at elution pH (low-pH viral inactivation load)
equipment: laboratory scale-down column packed with the commercial Protein A resin

source_references.quote: Protein A chromatography is the capture step of the A-Mab purification train.
The antibody is then eluted at low pH and passed to low-pH viral inactivation (Step 6) without neutralization.
Development site | Cambridge, MA
Commercial drug substance site | Grafton, WI

statements.statement_text: PCP-005 is the protocol for the process characterization of the Protein A chromatography step (Step 5), and applies PCMP-001 to the step.

source_references.quote: This plan is the protocol for the process characterization of the Protein A chromatography step (Step 5) of the A-Mab drug substance process.

statements.statement_text: Of the 6 process parameters, 4 are studied in a screening design followed by a response-surface design, and 2 one factor at a time.

source_references.quote: Of these, 4 are studied in a screening design followed by a response-surface design, and 2 are studied one factor at a time.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 is a protocol amendment issued under INV-001 after the studies of the step had been executed.

source_references.quote: This Version 2.0 is a protocol amendment issued after that execution, under the investigation INV-001.

statements.statement_text: Version 1.0 of the plan contained no approved criterion for the step.

source_references.quote: For this step, Version 1.0 of this plan contained no approved plan criterion.

statements.statement_text: The Version 2.0 criterion for pool host cell protein, 17,069 ng/mg, is wider than the Version 1.0 analysis limit of 10,724 ng/mg that Version 1.0 of PCR-005 applied.

source_references.quote: The Version 2.0 criterion for pool host cell protein, 17,069 ng/mg, is wider than the Version 1.0 analysis limit of 10,724 ng/mg.

statements.statement_text: The Version 1.0 analysis limit was never an approved criterion, so the wider Version 2.0 criterion does not loosen one.

source_references.quote: The Version 1.0 limit was never an approved criterion, so the wider Version 2.0 criterion does not loosen one.

statements.statement_text: The intermediate acceptance criteria are derived without data from the Protein A studies, so they may be applied to studies already executed.

source_references.quote: Because this derivation uses no data from the Protein A studies, it may be applied to studies that were already executed.

statements.statement_text: The amendment adds no run, removes none and repeats none; factors, ranges and designs are those of Version 1.0.

source_references.quote: No run is added, removed or repeated by this amendment.

statements.statement_text: The drug substance criteria do not apply to the Protein A pool directly; each output with a downstream dependence is judged against an intermediate acceptance criterion.

source_references.quote: The drug substance criteria do not apply to the Protein A pool directly.

statements.statement_text: SEC overstates fragments in the Protein A pool, so fragments are measured by nrCE-SDS and SEC fragment results are not used for any decision.

source_references.quote: For this reason SEC overstates fragments in the Protein A pool, and nrCE-SDS does not (INV-001 finding 6).

statements.statement_text: For a quantity compared at both scales that has a criterion, each scale-down result is translated to manufacturing scale by subtracting the offset before it is judged.

source_references.quote: For a quantity that is compared at both scales and has a criterion, each scale-down result is translated to manufacturing scale by subtracting the offset before it is judged.

statements.statement_text: The model is qualified for such a quantity when its conclusion over the NOR is the same with the offset at either end of its confidence interval.

source_references.quote: The model is qualified for such a quantity when its conclusion over the NOR is the same with the offset at either end of the confidence interval.

statements.statement_text: Fragments are not measured in the scale-down qualification, so they carry no offset and are judged as the response-surface model predicts them.

source_references.quote: The qualification therefore has no fragment result at either scale, and fragments carry no offset.

statements.statement_text: Leached Protein A is expected to be lower in the laboratory column than at manufacturing scale, because the manufacturing load is held longer before capture.

source_references.quote: Leached Protein A is expected to be lower in the laboratory column than at manufacturing scale, because the manufacturing load is held longer before capture

statements.statement_text: The difference between the scales for leached Protein A is its offset, and it is subtracted as every offset is.

source_references.quote: This difference is the offset of leached Protein A, and it is subtracted as every offset is.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface model is the predictive model of the step, and every prediction and every PAR in PCR-005 comes from it.

source_references.quote: The response-surface model is the predictive model of the step, and every prediction and every PAR in PCR-005 comes from it.

statements.statement_text: The NOR-propagated PAR, judged on the 95 % prediction interval of a single batch, is the one that supports a claim.

source_references.quote: The NOR-propagated PAR is the one that supports a claim.

statements.statement_text: A PAR is never claimed beyond the range studied.

source_references.quote: A PAR is never claimed beyond the range studied (PCMP-001, proven acceptable ranges).

statements.statement_text: The protein load NOR in this plan, 20–40 g/L resin, is the NOR against which the studies were planned and judged; PCR-005 Version 2.0 narrowed it to 20–39 g/L resin.
